name: [Negative] High Brokerage Charges
description: Users are expressing frustration and concern about the high brokerage charges on the app, leading to a negative experience and a potential loss of trust. The charges are perceived as excessive compared to other apps, and users are requesting a reduction or a more transparent fee structure.

name: [Negative] Excessive Brokerage Costs
description: Users are criticizing Groww for charging high brokerage fees, which they feel are excessively high and eat into their profits.

name: [Negative] Brokerage Charges
description: Users are complaining about high brokerage charges, inconsistent fees, and excessive charges that can lead to significant losses.

name: [Negative] High Brokerage Charges
description: Users are complaining about high brokerage charges, hidden fees, and lack of transparency in charges. They feel that the app is overcharging them, making it difficult to make profits. Some users even feel cheated due to the high charges.

name: [Negative] High Brokerage & Poor UI
description: Users are extremely dissatisfied with the high brokerage charges and poor user interface. They find it difficult to navigate and perform transactions without any hiccups. Many users expressed frustration over the hidden charges, high brokerage fees, and lack of transparency in the fees structure.
